name: Little Eau Pleine River
gaugeName: LITTLE EAU PLEINE RIVER NEAR MARSHFIELD, WI
blurb: Little Eau Pleine River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.

putInAccess.operator: Mead Wildlife Area (ownership 'Wisconsin DNR' in the WDNR record)
putInAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency-listed access area; the marker does not identify the exact water-edge landing. Confirm the signed approach and current access conditions with the site manager. DNR notes that non-DNR sites in this inventory are not actively maintained.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public approach to Highway S Launch. The map shows the access area; find the designated landing on arrival and check current site conditions.

takeOutAccess.operator: Mead Wildlife Area (ownership 'Wisconsin DNR' in the WDNR record)
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Agency-listed access area; the marker does not identify the exact water-edge landing. Confirm the signed approach and current access conditions with the site manager. DNR notes that non-DNR sites in this inventory are not actively maintained. Supplied imagery review places the original pin at the ramp head or approach, not the water.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed public approach to Highway O Launch. The map shows the access area; find the designated landing on arrival and check current site conditions.

gaugeContext.note: This station is upstream of the accessed reach. Its readings are reference information, not a measured flow for every section or a float-time estimate.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS Water Data — monitoring location and Wisconsin gauge review

mapAuditNote: Access areas reviewed against current agency records. Exact water-edge landings have not been established for every endpoint; sections with unresolved permission or dam/portage questions are held separately.
